```python
import pygame
import sys
import random

pygame.init()

WIDTH, HEIGHT = 800, 500
PADDLE_W, PADDLE_H = 12, 90
BALL_SIZE = 12
PADDLE_SPEED = 6
BALL_SPEED_X = 5
BALL_SPEED_Y = 4
WIN_SCORE = 5
FPS = 60
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
BLACK = (0, 0, 0)

screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("Pong")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()
font = pygame.font.SysFont("arial", 32)
big_font = pygame.font.SysFont("arial", 40, bold=True)


def reset_ball(direction):
    return {
        "x": WIDTH // 2 - BALL_SIZE // 2,
        "y": HEIGHT // 2 - BALL_SIZE // 2,
        "vx": BALL_SPEED_X * direction,
        "vy": random.choice([-1, 1]) * BALL_SPEED_Y,
    }


def draw(paddles, ball, scores):
    screen.fill(BLACK)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, WHITE, (WIDTH // 2 - 1, 0, 2, HEIGHT))
    for p in paddles:
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, WHITE, p["rect"])
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, WHITE, (ball["x"], ball["y"], BALL_SIZE, BALL_SIZE))
    left_score = font.render(str(scores[0]), True, WHITE)
    right_score = font.render(str(scores[1]), True, WHITE)
    screen.blit(left_score, (WIDTH // 4 - left_score.get_width() // 2, 20))
    screen.blit(right_score, (3 * WIDTH // 4 - right_score.get_width() // 2, 20))


def main():
    paddles = [
        {"rect": pygame.Rect(20, HEIGHT // 2 - PADDLE_H // 2, PADDLE_W, PADDLE_H)},
        {"rect": pygame.Rect(WIDTH - 20 - PADDLE_W, HEIGHT // 2 - PADDLE_H // 2, PADDLE_W, PADDLE_H)},
    ]
    scores = [0, 0]
    ball = reset_ball(random.choice([-1, 1]))
    winner = None
    running = True

    while running:
        clock.tick(FPS)
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and winner is not None and event.key == pygame.K_r:
                scores = [0, 0]
                winner = None
                ball = reset_ball(random.choice([-1, 1]))
                for p in paddles:
                    p["rect"].centery = HEIGHT // 2

        keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
        if winner is None:
            if keys[pygame.K_w]:
                paddles[0]["rect"].y -= PADDLE_SPEED
            if keys[pygame.K_s]:
                paddles[0]["rect"].y += PADDLE_SPEED
            if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
                paddles[1]["rect"].y -= PADDLE_SPEED
            if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
                paddles[1]["rect"].y += PADDLE_SPEED
            for p in paddles:
                p["rect"].clamp_ip(pygame.Rect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT))

            ball["x"] += ball["vx"]
            ball["y"] += ball["vy"]
            ball_rect = pygame.Rect(ball["x"], ball["y"], BALL_SIZE, BALL_SIZE)

            if ball["y"] <= 0 or ball["y"] + BALL_SIZE >= HEIGHT:
                ball["vy"] *= -1
                ball["y"] = max(0, min(ball["y"], HEIGHT - BALL_SIZE))

            for i, p in enumerate(paddles):
                if ball_rect.colliderect(p["rect"]):
                    if (i == 0 and ball["vx"] < 0) or (i == 1 and ball["vx"] > 0):
                        ball["vx"] *= -1
                        ball["x"] = p["rect"].right if i == 0 else p["rect"].left - BALL_SIZE
                        offset = (ball["y"] + BALL_SIZE / 2 - p["rect"].centery) / (PADDLE_H / 2)
                        ball["vy"] = int(BALL_SPEED_Y * offset) or random.choice([-1, 1]) * 2

            if ball["x"] + BALL_SIZE < 0:
                scores[1] += 1
                ball = reset_ball(-1)
            elif ball["x"] > WIDTH:
                scores[0] += 1
                ball = reset_ball(1)

            for i, s in enumerate(scores):
                if s >= WIN_SCORE:
                    winner = i

        draw(paddles, ball, scores)
        if winner is not None:
            text = big_font.render("Player %d wins! Press R to restart" % (winner + 1), True, WHITE)
            screen.blit(text, (WIDTH // 2 - text.get_width() // 2, HEIGHT // 2 - 30))
        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()
    sys.exit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
import random
import tkinter as tk

WIDTH, HEIGHT = 800, 500
PADDLE_W, PADDLE_H = 12, 90
PADDLE_MARGIN = 20
BALL_SIZE = 12
PADDLE_SPEED = 6
BALL_SPEED_X = 5
BALL_SPEED_Y = 4
WIN_SCORE = 5
TICK_MS = 16


class PongGame:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        root.title("Pong")
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(root, width=WIDTH, height=HEIGHT,
                                bg="black", highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.pack()
        self.canvas.focus_set()
        root.bind("<KeyPress>", self._key_down)
        root.bind("<KeyRelease>", self._key_up)
        self.keys = set()
        self.left = self.canvas.create_rectangle(
            PADDLE_MARGIN, HEIGHT // 2 - PADDLE_H // 2,
            PADDLE_MARGIN + PADDLE_W, HEIGHT // 2 + PADDLE_H // 2, fill="white")
        self.right = self.canvas.create_rectangle(
            WIDTH - PADDLE_MARGIN - PADDLE_W, HEIGHT // 2 - PADDLE_H // 2,
            WIDTH - PADDLE_MARGIN, HEIGHT // 2 + PADDLE_H // 2, fill="white")
        self.ball = self.canvas.create_oval(0, 0, BALL_SIZE, BALL_SIZE, fill="white")
        self.canvas.create_line(WIDTH // 2, 0, WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT,
                                fill="white", dash=(4, 8))
        self.left_score_text = self.canvas.create_text(
            WIDTH // 4, 30, text="0", fill="white", font=("Arial", 32, "bold"))
        self.right_score_text = self.canvas.create_text(
            3 * WIDTH // 4, 30, text="0", fill="white", font=("Arial", 32, "bold"))
        self.message = None
        self.scores = [0, 0]
        self.winner = None
        self.ball_vx = 0
        self.ball_vy = 0
        self.reset_game()
        self.root.after(TICK_MS, self._tick)

    def _key_down(self, event):
        key = event.keysym.lower()
        if key == "r" and self.winner is not None:
            self.reset_game()
        self.keys.add(key)

    def _key_up(self, event):
        self.keys.discard(event.keysym.lower())

    def reset_game(self):
        self.scores = [0, 0]
        self.winner = None
        self.canvas.itemconfigure(self.left_score_text, text="0")
        self.canvas.itemconfigure(self.right_score_text, text="0")
        if self.message is not None:
            self.canvas.delete(self.message)
            self.message = None
        for paddle in (self.left, self.right):
            _, y1, _, y2 = self.canvas.coords(paddle)
            self.canvas.move(paddle, 0, HEIGHT // 2 - (y1 + y2) / 2)
        self.reset_ball(random.choice([-1, 1]))

    def reset_ball(self, direction):
        cx, cy = WIDTH // 2 - BALL_SIZE // 2, HEIGHT // 2 - BALL_SIZE // 2
        self.canvas.coords(self.ball, cx, cy, cx + BALL_SIZE, cy + BALL_SIZE)
        self.ball_vx = BALL_SPEED_X * direction
        self.ball_vy = random.choice([-1, 1]) * BALL_SPEED_Y

    def _tick(self):
        if self.winner is None:
            self._move_paddles()
            self._move_ball()
        self.root.after(TICK_MS, self._tick)

    def _move_paddles(self):
        for paddle, up_key, down_key in ((self.left, "w", "s"),
                                         (self.right, "up", "down")):
            dy = (PADDLE_SPEED if down_key in self.keys else 0) - \
                 (PADDLE_SPEED if up_key in self.keys else 0)
            if dy:
                self.canvas.move(paddle, 0, dy)
                _, y1, _, y2 = self.canvas.coords(paddle)
                if y1 < 0:
                    self.canvas.move(paddle, 0, -y1)
                elif y2 > HEIGHT:
                    self.canvas.move(paddle, 0, HEIGHT - y2)

    def _move_ball(self):
        self.canvas.move(self.ball, self.ball_vx, self.ball_vy)
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = self.canvas.coords(self.ball)
        if y1 <= 0 and self.ball_vy < 0:
            self.ball_vy *= -1
            self.canvas.move(self.ball, 0, -y1)
        elif y2 >= HEIGHT and self.ball_vy > 0:
            self.ball_vy *= -1
            self.canvas.move(self.ball, 0, HEIGHT - y2)
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = self.canvas.coords(self.ball)
        for paddle, going_left in ((self.left, True), (self.right, False)):
            px1, py1, px2, py2 = self.canvas.coords(paddle)
            if x1 < px2 and x2 > px1 and y1 < py2 and y2 > py1:
                if going_left and self.ball_vx < 0:
                    self.ball_vx = abs(self.ball_vx)
                    self.canvas.move(self.ball, px2 - x1, 0)
                    self._deflect(py1, py2)
                elif not going_left and self.ball_vx > 0:
                    self.ball_vx = -abs(self.ball_vx)
                    self.canvas.move(self.ball, px1 - x2, 0)
                    self._deflect(py1, py2)
        x1, _, x2, _ = self.canvas.coords(self.ball)
        if x2 < 0:
            self._score(1, -1)
        elif x1 > WIDTH:
            self._score(0, 1)

    def _deflect(self, py1, py2):
        ball_y = sum(self.canvas.coords(self.ball)[1::2]) / 2
        offset = (ball_y - (py1 + py2) / 2) / (PADDLE_H / 2)
        self.ball_vy = int(BALL_SPEED_Y * offset) or random.choice([-1, 1]) * 2

    def _score(self, index, direction):
        self.scores[index] += 1
        text = self.left_score_text if index == 0 else self.right_score_text
        self.canvas.itemconfigure(text, text=str(self.scores[index]))
        if self.scores[index] >= WIN_SCORE:
            self.winner = index
            self.message = self.canvas.create_text(
                WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2 - 20,
                text="Player %d wins! Press R to restart" % (index + 1),
                fill="white", font=("Arial", 24, "bold"))
        else:
            self.reset_ball(direction)


def main():
    root = tk.Tk()
    PongGame(root)
    root.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
